clue.text: Is he needed if a train's broken down?

definitions.text: Is he needed if a train's broken down?

indicators.note: a train that has broken down is out of order, so these letters are put in a new order

parts.note: the possessive's S counts here as a letter, giving TRAINS

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a mechanic is wanted when the train has failed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken down' rearranges A TRAINS; the whole clue also defines, since a skilled worker is who you call when a machine breaks.
explanation.definitionFit: A craftsman or skilled manual worker is the person summoned to repair broken machinery, so the question describes one.

clue.text: Enforced when a parish priest dissembled

parts.note: to dissemble is to deceive, so lied

explanation.surface: A rule was imposed when a clergyman pretended.
explanation.definitionFit: A law applied is one put into effect, made to operate.

clue.text: Connection that is apparent in setback

indicators.note: apparent in means visible inside, so the abbreviation sits within the other piece

parts.note: set is PUT, and back turns it round to give TUP
i.e. is short for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A link becomes obvious when something goes wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setback' splits into set (PUT) read back, TUP; i.e. sits inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tie-up is a link or association, for example between two companies.

clue.text: A producer of spirit even now

definitions.meaning: a distilling apparatus for making whisky

explanation.definitionFit: A still is distilling equipment, and still also means yet.

clue.text: A quartet in small house is most artless

indicators.note: in tells us these letters go inside the small house

parts.note: a nest is a small home, for a bird
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Four musicians in a tiny home are the most innocent.
explanation.definitionFit: Naive means innocent and unsophisticated; the superlative is the most guileless.

clue.text: Fierce tirade about article by metropolitan police

indicators.note: about means going round, so the tirade word wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: a tirade is a rant
A is the indefinite article
MP is the abbreviation for Metropolitan Police

explanation.surface: An angry outburst about a newspaper piece, aimed at London's police force.
explanation.walkthrough: The Metropolitan Police is London's police force, abbreviated MP in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Rampant can mean violent and unrestrained, as a lion on its hind legs is ferocious.

clue.text: Serviceman in uniform

definitions.meaning: a professional soldier in a standing army

explanation.definitionFit: A regular is a career soldier, and regular means even or consistent.

clue.text: Displays passenger lists

definitions.meaning: documents listing cargo or people aboard

explanation.definitionFit: Manifests means shows clearly, and as a noun means shipping lists.

clue.text: One heartens roguish, blunt man

indicators.note: heartens is read as puts at the heart, so one goes in the middle

parts.note: arch means mischievous or roguish
bald means plain and blunt
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A man encourages a cheeky, outspoken fellow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartens' looks like encourages but means puts in the heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Archibald is a man's given name.

clue.text: Where the drama of warfare is played out

definitions.text: Where the drama of warfare is played out

parts.words: Where the drama of warfare is played out
parts.note: a playhouse is where drama is performed, and the phrase of war names a region of combat

explanation.definitionFit: A playhouse stages plays, and a theatre of war is a region of combat operations.

clue.text: Showing bias before taking the chair

parts.note: pre- is a prefix meaning before
siding with someone is showing bias towards them

explanation.surface: A chairperson is accused of partiality before even starting the meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone presiding over a meeting is chairing it, the officer in charge.

clue.text: Headhunter in lovely, cosy position

indicators.note: in tells us the head letter goes inside the word for lovely

parts.note: lovely can mean nice
the head of hunter is its first letter, H

explanation.surface: A recruitment agent lands a pleasant, comfortable job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Headhunter' looks like a recruiter but splits into head + hunter, the first letter of hunter.
explanation.definitionFit: A niche is a comfortable, suitable role or place where someone fits snugly.

clue.text: I'm getting peas on a whim

parts.note: taken as written, without its apostrophe
peas are pulses, edible seeds of legumes

explanation.surface: Someone decides on the spur of the moment to have peas.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden urge or caprice drives impulsive action, just as a whim does.

clue.text: No Tory keeps record about English daily

indicators.note: keeps means holds inside, so the record word holds the next letters
about means surrounding, confirming that the record word goes round the others

parts.note: a list is a record
the FT, Financial Times, is a daily newspaper

explanation.surface: A Labour supporter keeps a diary on English daily life.
explanation.walkthrough: FT is the Financial Times, a British daily newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: A leftist is a socialist or left-winger, the opposite of a Conservative politically.

clue.text: Its light puts seaman in the shade

definitions.text: Its light puts seaman in the shade

parts.words: Its light puts seaman in the shade
parts.note: puts in the shade suggests overshadowing, a seaman is a tar, and the light belongs to a small faint body in the night sky

explanation.walkthrough: To put something in the shade is to dwarf it; a seaman is a TAR, and the whole names a faint celestial body.
explanation.definitionFit: A small dim star of low luminosity gives off a weak light, a celestial body sailors might once have steered by.

clue.text: Opening up when making one's confession

definitions.meaning: letting someone in, opening the door to them
owning up to a fault or crime

explanation.definitionFit: Admitting means both allowing entry and confessing guilt.

clue.text: Van, van, van

parts.note: the van of an army is its fore part
the van is also the front

explanation.surface: Three repeats of one word, like a vehicle listed three times.
explanation.walkthrough: Van here is short for vanguard, the leading part, not a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: The vanguard is the leading position, the foremost place in an advance.

clue.text: Urbane American returns greeting

indicators.note: returns means goes back, so the American abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: ave is a Latin greeting, hail

explanation.surface: A polished American comes back with a salutation.
explanation.definitionFit: Suave and urbane both describe smooth, sophisticated manners.

clue.text: Jack embraces a married banker

indicators.note: embraces means hugs, so the sailor word holds the other letters

parts.note: a jack tar is a sailor, TAR

explanation.surface: A man called Jack hugs a wedded financier.
explanation.walkthrough: A banker in crosswords is a river, which has banks; the Tamar divides Devon from Cornwall.
explanation.definitionFit: A river has banks, so crosswords call one a banker; the Tamar is an English river.

clue.text: Coalpit collapse in the news

indicators.note: a collapse breaks the structure down, so the letters fall into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A mine caving in makes headlines.
explanation.definitionFit: Topical means of current interest, the kind of subject journalists report on.

clue.text: Rears to support crews

parts.note: to back is to support
crews or teams are sides

explanation.surface: Rearing children to support the people who work with them.
explanation.definitionFit: Rears and backsides are both words for bottoms.

clue.text: Dance with nothing on? Swell!

parts.note: a ball is a formal dance
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A naked dance? How splendid!
explanation.definitionFit: To balloon is to swell or expand rapidly.

clue.text: Most recent charge

definitions.meaning: up to date, belonging to now

explanation.definitionFit: Current means present-day, and also a flow of electricity.

clue.text: Maybe wrestle in vain against the heat

definitions.text: Maybe wrestle in vain against the heat

indicators.note: maybe signals a possible form of the word, so its letters can be rearranged

explanation.surface: A struggle that gets nowhere in oppressive heat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maybe' rearranges WRESTLE; the whole clue also describes suffering in heat.
explanation.definitionFit: To swelter is to suffer oppressive heat, a hopeless struggle against high temperature.

clue.text: Sorry if tulip is misshapen

indicators.note: misshapen means bent out of form, so the letters are reshaped into a new order

explanation.surface: A gardener apologises for a deformed flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorry can mean wretched or pathetic, a sense shared with pitiful.

clue.text: Back minister from Ireland

parts.note: Rev, Reverend, is a minister's title
Erse is the Irish Gaelic language

explanation.surface: Supporting a clergyman who comes from Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: To back a car is to drive it in reverse.

clue.text: Very old lawyer imbibes cocktail containing spirit

indicators.note: imbibes means drinks in, so the lawyer abbreviation takes in the letter

parts.note: DA, District Attorney, is an American lawyer
the tail of cock is its last letter, K

explanation.surface: An elderly attorney drinks a mixed drink containing alcohol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cocktail' splits into cock + tail, its last letter K.
explanation.definitionFit: Vodka is a clear distilled alcoholic drink, a spirit.

clue.text: Laughing Scotsman in outskirts of Rabat

indicators.note: in tells us the name goes inside the outer letters
outskirts are the edges, so take the first and last letters

parts.note: Ian is a typical Scottish name

explanation.surface: A Scot is amused on the edge of a Moroccan city.
explanation.walkthrough: Rabat is the capital of Morocco.
explanation.definitionFit: Riant is a literary word for cheerful or smiling.

clue.text: Atmosphere in business needing capital

indicators.note: in tells us the atmosphere word goes inside the business abbreviation

parts.note: Co is short for company, a business
air is atmosphere

explanation.surface: A firm's mood suffers when it needs funding.
explanation.definitionFit: Cairo is the capital city of Egypt.

clue.text: Credit given on getting bill of exchange

parts.note: over can mean on, as in on top of
a draft is a bill of exchange, an order to pay money

explanation.surface: A bank lends against a written payment order.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank grants this facility, letting an account go below zero as a loan.

clue.text: Dispel darkness to offer relief

definitions.meaning: ease a burden, make it less heavy

explanation.definitionFit: Lighten means both to brighten and to reduce a load.

clue.text: Characteristic men found in a rat

parts.note: a trait is a characteristic
OR, other ranks, means soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: A typical feature of people discovered in a rodent.
explanation.walkthrough: OR, other ranks, is a common crossword abbreviation for men.
explanation.definitionFit: A rat in slang is a betrayer who informs on or deserts companions.
